name: autoclip
description: AutoClip｜一个链接，一键出片。开源 AI 视频剪辑桌面工具，将播客、访谈、课程等长视频自动剪成短视频，生成字幕、封面和发布文案，适配抖音、小红书、TikTok、Reels 与 YouTube Shorts。Open-source AI video clipping & content repurposing.
one_liner: Software that automatically turns a long podcast or video into short, captioned clips ready to post on TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube Shorts.
buyer: A podcast host or local business owner who records long-form video or livestreams but has no time to cut clips for social media.
business_use_cases: A done-for-you agency offers a 'turn your podcast into a week of social clips' subscription for local podcasters, coaches, and realtors.
A social media manager uses it to repurpose a small business's weekly livestream into daily short-form posts.
A niche shop clips gaming or Twitch streams into highlight reels for streamers who want a highlights channel but can't edit themselves.

money_ideas.idea: Subscription 'weekly clips' service for recurring podcast or livestream clients
One-off per-video clipping service for creators who just need a single episode repurposed

steal_this: Offer one local podcaster a free trial week turning their latest episode into 10 clips, then sell a monthly package.
